    var expl = current.getValue('explanation');
    var fit = current.getValue('fit_score');
    var skills = current.getValue('skills_score');
    var exp = current.getValue('experience_score');
    var proj = current.getValue('projects_score');
    var certs = current.getValue('certifications_score');
    var edu = current.getValue('education_score');

    if (!expl || expl.toString().trim() === '' ||

        certs === null || edu === null) {

        gs.addErrorMessage('AEGIS Governance: A screening result cannot be completed without an auditable factor breakdown (all 5 scores) and explanation.');
    }
})(current, previous);
